__schema.description: Per-Pokémon absolute availability. `games` is the COMPLETE list of finalized games where the species can be obtained — no defaults, no deltas. Forms can override their parent via `forms.{formId}.games`. Missing species = not yet curated.

fields.games: Absolute list of game ids where this species can be obtained.
fields.event: true if the species is acquired via event distribution.
fields.forms: Optional per-form availability map. Keys are form ids (e.g. "tauros-paldea-blaze-breed"). A form entry replaces the species `games` for that form.

__finalized_games.note: Games whose Pokédex has been verified. Other games are intentionally absent until curated.
